completion_budget_decision: 4096 plus estimated input exceeded the 7200-token safe quota scenario for two prompts. Use 3072 for C1/C2, preserving every document and schema; freeze before observing outcomes.
execution_policy: No predictions are executed by preparation or rehearsal. Paid generation and official scoring require a separate authorized runner.

planning_rate_ceilings.basis: Engineering reservation ceilings only, not provider prices. Confirm current model prices do not exceed these ceilings before enabling calls.

quota_scenario.basis: 90% of previously recorded 8000 TPM / 200000 TPD; not verified current account quota

retry_policy: At most one retry after explicit HTTP 429 rejection, reserving again; never retry ambiguous failures or incomplete completions. Resume complete responses without calls.
token_bound: Pinned local o200k ordinary-text count, plus 256 chat-template allowance and 15% margin. Provider template requires confirmation; this is an estimate, not an exact API count.
